title: Karim Barras
summary:
Karim Barras is a French-Swiss actor who voiced Den Fears in the French dub of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. 

Prior to Den's appearance in Season 2, he voiced the Elder Guardian of Thor, Unnamed Suit 013 and Eathon Lambert in Season 1.
full_text:
Karim Barras is a French-Swiss actor who voiced Den Fears in the French dub of Huntik: Secrets & Seekers. 

Prior to Den's appearance in Season 2, he voiced the Elder Guardian of Thor, Unnamed Suit 013 and Eathon Lambert in Season 1.
